FCI005-G04B.qualification: Apply when result membership requires realization evidence; otherwise use G04A.

OrientCarrierBridge_x.role: Relate a source operand or transformation carrier to an observation orientation without identifying the two types.

SourceContextBridge_x.role: Relate the source composition context to the observation admissibility context.

DistinctionThresholdBridge_x.role: Preserve the source distinction-floor decision and its failure semantics under projection.
DistinctionThresholdBridge_x.undefined_policy: Undefined threshold comparison or translation yields UNDEFINED_BRIDGE, not FALSE.

FCI005DistinctionBridgeWitness_x.signature: FCI005DistinctionBridgeWitness_x(X, Z, Y, o_i, o_j; epsilon_x, B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
definition: D(X|Z) is prebound and evaluable before RefOrient_x and delta_a.
d_obs(o_i,o_j) is evaluable before RefOrient_x and delta_a.

binary_candidate.signature: BCon_FCI005Distinction_x(o_i, o_j; epsilon_x, B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
binary_candidate.definition: Exists X, Z, Y such that FCI005DistinctionBridgeWitness_x(X, Z, Y, o_i, o_j; epsilon_x, B_x, D_rel, R).
binary_candidate.source_witness_policy: X, Z, and Y are existential bridge witnesses, not public BCon_x parameters.
binary_candidate.threshold_policy: The source and observation distinction-floor decisions must be linked by DistinctionThresholdBridge_x; d_obs > epsilon_x may not silently replace D(X|Z) > epsilon_x.
binary_candidate.symmetry_policy: Unless the source distinction is directed, require or prove BCon_FCI005Distinction_x(o_i,o_j) iff BCon_FCI005Distinction_x(o_j,o_i).

bridge_tests.success: Source carriers have observation-orientation representatives without type identity or completed RefOrient dependency.
Source context maps to B_x, D_rel, and R before [Asym]_x, <S>_x, and delta_a realization.
Projected threshold decision preserves source distinction-collapse success and failure states.
Threshold type, domain, provenance, and translation rule are declared.
No bridge requires RefOrient_x, [Asym]_x, <S>_x, delta_a, or realized closure.

prohibited: Binding G01 as a binary constraint.
Binding FCI005-G06A without proving prebound class availability.
Binding BCon_FCI005Distinction_x before all bridge tests pass.
next_action: Run the five bridge tests against FCI005-G02.
failure_condition: Any dependency on completed RefOrient_x, [Asym]_x, <S>_x, delta_a, or realized closure disqualifies FCI005-G02 from BCon_x eligibility.
